statements.quote: The hypotheses, design, sample size, and analysis plan for Study 1 were registered prior to data collection (https://aspredicted.org/bgmj-yrm4.pdf). Notable deviations include: (a) the addition of an intermediate condition to allow a more precise test of the feedback effect; (b) the use of a correlational approach to analyze evaluation accuracy, replacing the preregistered squared-difference score method; (c) the inclusion of both engineers and non-engineers to examine potential domain-specific effects. To account for these changes, a larger sample size was recruited. All deviations are further justified in the relevant sections. Study 2 was not preregistered. All materials, data, and analysis scripts for both studies are publicly accessible on the Open Science Framework https://osf.io/6k52d/?view_only=398df4fd924440ee9387af4f6434d422.

notes.summary: Public output-level data with participant identifiers, per-row arm assignments and originality scores were downloaded and read for both studies. Study 1 includes full idea texts; Study 2 includes drawing titles but no confirmed drawing images. The same project is linked as both data_url and code_url in the screening form and was independently rediscovered through DataCite and OSF title searches; it is counted once.
notes.primary_fields: rows_checked and columns_checked refer to dataset_response_level_s1.sav. The two additional fully inspected workbooks, including their row counts and column names, are recorded below.

file_inspections.filter: Keep rows with nonmissing dt_response_invalid, dt_prompt_low_fluency, subject_reject_copypaste, subject_reject_mobile and subject_reject_duration, each != 1, matching analysis_script_s1.R lines 183-188.

file_inspections.note: The XLSX adds idea_id, alternative-model and human-rating columns, and repeat_participant_excluded to the 64-column SAV. The original filters reproduce 7,174 rows and 554 unique subjects in both formats. Current files identify one subject participating in both active_feedback and active_control. Applying the additional XLSX repeat_participant_excluded==0 flag to the original filtered rows is a sensitivity analysis: 7,158 rows, 553 unique subjects, and mutually exclusive arm counts 189 continuous, 180 intermediate, 184 control. Do not silently substitute this newer exclusion for the saved preprint's sample.

file_inspections.filter: analysis_script_s2.R lines 146-149: dt_response_order <= 2 and nonmissing dt_response_time_reject != 1. Original response-order values are preserved; responses are not renumbered after exclusions.
file_inspections.note: The current XLSX contains 94,455 rows and 37,823 people before exclusions. The posted filter yields exactly the paper's 77,142 rows and 36,198 people (18,136 immediate; 18,062 delayed), showing those reported totals already correspond to the first-two restriction in these data. Only 75,244 filtered rows have the original outcome score. Second-drawing rows with observed scores number 27,509 from 21,118 people (7,328 rows/6,057 people immediate; 20,181 rows/15,061 people delayed). These are observed-score counts computed from the current XLSX, not a refitted mixed-model sample. Drawing titles are actual text, sometimes short or invalid; they are not substitutes for images. All nonmissing image references are .png filenames, none are URLs, the workbook contains no embedded media, and the repository file inventory contains no drawing images.

notes.public_access: The paper's view-only link returned HTTP 200. https://osf.io/6k52d/ and https://api.osf.io/v2/nodes/6k52d/ also returned 200 without a token, cookies or account; node metadata public=true. OSF children endpoint returned zero child nodes. All folders and pagination links were exhausted; n_files=19 counts files recursively and excludes folders.
notes.license_evidence: No license is exposed on the OSF node metadata or among the listed files; https://api.datacite.org/dois/10.17605/osf.io/6k52d returned HTTP 200 with rightsList=[]. The preprint's separate license is not assumed to license these datasets.
notes.version_caveat: The saved manuscript is the May 2025 preprint. The current Study 1 SAV and main R scripts were modified on 2026-01-31; both XLSX datasets and supplementary analyses were modified on 2026-08-10. Current files include later human/model scores and a repeat-participant flag. Use dt_response_originality_score for the saved manuscript's original outcome, and distinguish its original exclusions from later sensitivity analyses.
notes.allocation_material: qualtrics_experiment.qsf (HTTP 200; modified 2024-12-06) contains Survey Flow FL_133, Type=BlockRandomizer, SubSet=1, EvenPresentation=true, with branches FL_134/135/136 setting param_condition to active_feedback/active_control/passive_control. The practice and test branches confirm the arm mapping given above. This supplies the survey-randomizer evidence sought by final.open_items[0], although a posted configuration alone does not certify which version was actually deployed. The raw and cleaned datasets each contain one subject ID in both active arms.
notes.analysis_code: Both main R scripts returned HTTP 200 and were read, not executed. Study 1 line 774 passes sigma(originality.lmm_1) and df.residual(originality.lmm_1) to emmeans::eff_size. Study 2 lines 613 and 629 remove the dt_prompt random intercept for post-hoc models; lines 626 and 649-651 use those models' sigma and residual degrees of freedom for eff_size. This documents the standardizer and a model difference relevant to the form's precision question; the original model/post-hoc output still needs reproduction before resolving every printed number.
notes.download_limits: Only files below 20,000,000 bytes were downloaded, all into memory. The 29,692,208-byte Study 2 SAV and 1,231,477,238-byte model checkpoint were listed but not downloaded. Study 2 was inspected via its 8,590,069-byte XLSX. No actual drawing assets were found.

notes.summary: Public preregistration #163881, AI-Feedback and Engineering/Design Creativity, preregistered 2024-02-27 at 08:33 PT. The named .pdf URL now returns an HTML presentation (HTTP 200). Its Download PDF link returned a one-page application/pdf file (HTTP 200; Content-Disposition filename=AsPredicted #163881.pdf), read in memory.
notes.content: The preregistration describes two planned conditions, feedback versus no feedback, and feedback for all participants in the warm-up. It describes originality and squared-difference metacognitive accuracy outcomes, planned multilevel analyses, and exclusions. It contains no participant observations, realized assignments, scores or participant outputs. It does not explicitly state random allocation and does not document the later third arm.

what_we_could_compute: For S1-O1, S1-O2 and S2-O1, calculate participant-level means of the original originality scores, arm-level means/SDs/SEs of those participant values, and counts with observed outcomes. Participant IDs and prompt/order columns permit either output-weighted or equal-prompt averages; the weighting and missing-score rules must be specified. S1's participant appearing in two arms needs explicit treatment before treating arms as independent.

Address final.open_items[2] using S1 subject IDs, arm labels and exclusion flags: reproduce 629 unique raw IDs versus 630 subject-arm memberships, and 554 unique filtered IDs versus 555 subject-arm memberships. Identify the one repeated participant and report the later repeat-exclusion sensitivity separately. These data explain the discrepancy, but do not justify silently changing the preprint's counts.

Address final.open_items[3] using S2 subject IDs, dt_prompt/dt_prompt_order, dt_response_order and dt_response_time_reject: compute retained people and drawings after the first-two restriction, and first-/second-drawing counts by arm, with nonmissing outcome counts separately. The checked XLSX and original script filter reproduce 77,142 retained rows and 36,198 people; 27,509 scored second-drawing rows come from 21,118 people.

Address final.open_items[5] by inspecting and rerunning the posted R models/post-hoc code to recover the residual-SD standardizer, contrast orientation and model-specific SEs/CIs, including Study 2 post-hoc models that drop the shape random intercept. Code is available, but R was not run and exact numerical discrepancies with the PDF are not claimed resolved.

Compute within-person and between-person/arm text-diversity measures for Study 1 using dt_response_text, subject, param_condition and dt_prompt. Study 2 permits diversity measures on drawing titles only after appropriate text-quality filtering; visual diversity of the drawings cannot be computed from the inspected public files because actual images were not located.

notes.scope: Data availability is confirmed for both studies, independently of the atlas's unsettled intervention-scope decisions. High confidence refers to public access and observed identifiers/arms/outcomes. It does not certify every reported statistic, the historical deployment of the survey, or completeness of the drawing-image archive.
notes.full_text_review: Read all 1,493 lines (92,225 characters) of the markdown conversion, including all references and Supplementary Materials, and checked key statements directly with PyMuPDF on the 52-page PDF. Quotes are verbatim text excerpts with layout whitespace normalized and manuscript line numbers omitted. No source, screening form or other file was edited.

publisher_landing.result: The OSF preprint API identifies version 1 as the latest version, gives no published-article DOI, and links data to https://osf.io/6k52d/ and preregistration to https://aspredicted.org/bgmj-yrm4.pdf. The files API returned only preprint_manuscript_with_supplementary_materials.pdf (1,412,370 bytes), matching the saved PDF's size. Its supplement is included in that manuscript; the separate linked project holds the datasets.

notes.search_limits: No general web search was used. All remote checks used Python urllib with User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1 and no personal identifier. Initial Zenodo size=100 searches failed with HTTP 400 and were retried at the public limit size=25. The broad DataCite surname search returned many namesakes; the refined creator-name query returned 15 records and was reviewed in full. No additional confirmed deposit was found beyond the named OSF project. OSF's prescribed title filter is not an author-index search.
notes.reference_link_note: All 50 distinct HTTP(S) link annotations in the PDF were requested, including bibliography links. Bibliographic articles are not counted as deposits for c280. HTTP 403 responses were recorded and not bypassed; they did not prevent access to the paper's data or preregistration.
notes.unresolved: The original drawing images and a dataset-specific reuse license were not confirmed. The atlas's GPT-3 ratings-only scope question and inconsistent training/validation-rater counts are not settled by this availability check. No inferential models were rerun.
